name: qdi-mfs-fifteencap-300000
description: Married filing separately with long-term gains crossing the 15% band ceiling. The QDIVCG worksheet line 13 breakpoint is a flat $300,000 for MFS - NOT half of the $600,050 MFJ breakpoint. This fixture pinned and corrected the engine's former 300,025 value (which produced $38,596.25 instead of $38,597.50). Also exercises the $125,000 MFS NIIT threshold.

source.publication: Instructions for Form 1040 (2025), Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet-Line 16, line 13; Instructions for Form 8960 (2025)
source.pin: Worksheet line 13 verbatim: 'Enter: $533,400 if single, $300,000 if married filing separately, $600,050 if married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse, $566,700 if head of household.' Form 8960 thresholds: 'Married filing separately is $125,000.'

derivation: LTCG $320,000 only; MFS standard deduction $15,750; taxable income $304,250, all preferential.
0% band: MFS zero breakpoint (worksheet line 6) $48,350 at 0%.
Preferential tax = 37,747.50 + 850.00 = $38,597.50. (A 300,025 cap would give 38,596.25 - this fixture distinguishes them.)
